title: Fidelity contract
description: Declares the approved canvas and every rectangle a Render Pass is licensed to change. Any pixel outside every declared region must remain byte identical to the approved baseline.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Candidate and baseline must both match it.

approvedBaseline.description: Path to the approved baseline image this contract judges against.

mutableRegions.description: Rectangles licensed to change. Regions must not overlap, so every changed pixel is attributable to exactly one region.

name.description: Unique, human-readable name for the licensed change.
